Container.Name: Purgarr
Container.Overview: Discord bot for deletion requests. Users run /delete movie or /delete tv and pick a title from your library, admins get a card with the poster and Delete/Decline buttons, and approved titles are deleted through Radarr/Sonarr.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Developer Portal: your app, Bot, Reset Token.

Config.Name: Admin channel ID
Config.Description: Private channel for review cards. Right-click the channel, Copy Channel ID (needs Developer Mode).

Config.Name: Admin role IDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated role IDs that may Delete/Decline. Members with Administrator or Manage Server always can.

Config.Name: Requester role IDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated role IDs that may request deletions. Empty means everyone.

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Your server IP and Radarr port, for example http://192.168.1.50:7878 (not localhost). Leave empty if you don't use Radarr.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Your server IP and Sonarr port, for example http://192.168.1.50:8989 (not localhost). Leave empty if you don't use Sonarr.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true = approve requests without deleting anything, for testing.

Config.Name: Add import exclusion
Config.Description: true = stop import lists (Trakt, Plex watchlist) from re-adding deleted titles.
